correctness.rationale: At every nonzero projective hollow symmetric rank<=2 point, rank cannot be one in characteristic zero (w_i^2=0), hence some off-diagonal pivot s=x_ab is invertible. Schur complement elimination identifies the entire localized ALL-3-minor ideal with diagonal equations 2u_i v_i=0 and off-pivot variables determined by (u_iv_j+v_iu_j)/s. Projective chart is C[u_i,v_i]/(u_i v_i), proving radical local complete intersection, Segre components indexed by bipartitions, saturated intersection of their primes, and 1/2 binom(2n-2,n-1) degree. At any point z zero rows correspond exactly to z nodal pairs and remaining smooth coordinates; completed local algebra is product of z nodes, multiplicity 2^z, Hilbert (1+t)^z/(1-t)^(n-2), smooth iff z=0. Independent symbolic full 3-minor checks n=3,4,5 recover exactly 1,16,100 minors; all n supported by symbolic Schur argument, not finite extrapolation.
residual_risks: Finite checking establishes only the enumerated finite cases, not any all-n assertion.
